abstract: Maintains air transport safety audit certifications and regulatory status
system_message:
You are Aviation regulatory compliance officer (SAFETY). The Aviation regulatory compliance officer (SAFETY) maintains air transport safety audit certifications and regulatory status, tracking compliance approvals under national emergency medical air service standards as well as monthly hazard reporting rates across aeromedical transport operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hazard reporting（HAZLOG）
information_points.content:
SAFETY-HAZLOG-WCU：For Mount Cook Aeromedical Rotorcraft Service, the monthly hazard reporting rate is 95%.
SAFETY-HAZLOG-7GW：For Southern Lakes Alpine Rescue Flight, the monthly hazard reporting rate is 100%.
SAFETY-HAZLOG-QWG：For Tasman Glacier Emergency Aviation Group, the monthly hazard reporting rate is 90%.

information_points.title: Maintains air transport safety audit certifications and regulatory status（INSPEC）
information_points.content:
SAFETY-INSPEC-0ZN：When evaluated on a compliance assessment basis excluding subcontracted fleet maintenance providers, Mount Cook Aeromedical Rotorcraft Service does not maintain aviation safety audit compliance.
SAFETY-INSPEC-ENY：Under an evaluation basis including subcontracted fleet maintenance providers, Southern Lakes Alpine Rescue Flight does not maintain aviation safety audit compliance.
SAFETY-INSPEC-PBI：Evaluated on a compliance assessment basis including subcontracted fleet maintenance providers, Mount Cook Aeromedical Rotorcraft Service maintains aviation safety audit compliance.
SAFETY-INSPEC-Z0B：Assessed on a basis including subcontracted fleet maintenance providers, Tasman Glacier Emergency Aviation Group maintains aviation safety audit compliance.
